title: Nine-distance theorem and growth of best-approximation denominators
summary: We prove a nine-distance theorem for Kronecker sequences on flat three-tori. That is, we show that among the first $N$ orbit points, at most nine distinct positive nearest-neighbour distances occur. This proves the conjecture of Haynes and Marklof. An example of Dettmann shows that nine is optimal. More generally, we prove that on a flat $d$-dimensional torus the number of such distances is at most $2^d+1$. The main tool is a new growth theorem for the denominators $q_1<q_2<\cdots$ of best simultaneous approximations in a $d$-dimensional inner-product space, which is of independent interest.…
